### Item 6 — problem tree from visible materials alone

Problems: P1 root (customer's write) Payment Extension on GARAGE; P2 catch-up forgiveness on HOME AMP inst 12; P3 missed program-bill entry on HOME AMP inst 12; P4 reinstatement of PECK WPP. Edges: P1 ← P2 ← P3; P1 ← P4. Order: P3, P2 (and P4 anywhere before P1), then P1.

- Hop P1 → P2 — **state-derived.** Extension card term 2: "The amount carried by a payment extension is fixed only after every program bill of the customer that has been paid in full carries the forgiveness entry owed for it." Records: HOME program bill f8cd4801 paid in full today (199.76 = 196.81 + 2.95, balance 0.00), no forgiveness entry for installment 12 on the AMP ledger. Searching "forgiveness entry" / "paid in full" finds the catch-up card: "the withheld forgiveness is posted as a catch-up once that bill is paid in full, on the day it is paid in full, while the plan is active and has not defaulted" and its posting tool — the write that makes the state hold. "Program bill" vocabulary is that of the AMP documents.
- Hop P2 → P3 — **state-derived.** Catch-up card: "A catch-up forgiveness is not posted until the plan carries a missed-installment entry for the program bill it is earned on wherever that bill was still unpaid when its cure period ended." Records: bill due 2026-07-31, no payment on HOME between 2026-06-30 and 2026-08-11 → unpaid at end of cure period 2026-08-10; no missed entry on the AMP plan. Searching "missed-installment entry" + "program bill" finds "Missed Program Bill Entries": "whose current charges are still unpaid when its cure period ends is booked as a missed-installment entry … on the day after the cure period ends" and its tool.
- Hop P1 → P4 — **state-derived.** Extension card term 3: "The amount carried by a payment extension is not worked out until every Winter Protection Plan of the customer that defaulted and has had its missed installments and good-faith payment paid inside its reinstatement window stands active again." Records: PECK WPP defaulted 2026-08-07; payments 275.00 after default ≥ 106.42 + 13.17 within window → the plan qualifies and is not active. Searching "Winter Protection Plan … active again" / "good-faith payment" finds the WPP seasonal desk card ("On reinstatement the winter plan returns to active") with its tool.
- No action-named and no pre-solved hops found. None of the dependent documents names another problem's tool.

### Two-way counter-proof

- "Do only the extension": excluded by terms 2 and 3 of the extension card plus the records (paid-in-full program bill without forgiveness; qualifying defaulted WPP). The dry-run numbers also show the visible factor docs would then give a different upfront share (24%), so the governed result would be fixed on a state the card forbids.
- "Post forgiveness without the missed entry": excluded by the catch-up card's "not posted until the plan carries a missed-installment entry".
- "Full catch-up (share 1) / regular forgiveness posting term": excluded by the catch-up memo and factor docs; the fact sheet's on-time posting term (day after due date) does not apply because the bill was not paid by its due date (AMP rules truth table: "No, later paid in full → Withheld forgiveness posted once the bill is paid in full").
- "Refuse WPP reinstatement for unpaid good-faith" excluded by the payments (275.00 ≥ 119.59).
- "Extension base = account balance 262.18 / past-due balance": excluded by the notice-stage table (written notice, no final → 188.78).
- "Count the card payment / all booking-day payments": excluded by "A card, online or autopay payment posted on the booking day … is never recognised".
- "Count the payment reversal as a returned-payment charge": excluded by the definition "the charge the … ledger records when a payment is returned unpaid" and the separate event types.
- Open point on the visible side (not a defect claim): the restoration/good-faith payment amounts have no stated rounding; they serve only as a threshold here and the threshold is met either way.

Blind conclusion: missed entry 50.47 (inst 12, bill f8cd4801) → catch-up forgiveness 49.71 → WPP re-deferral 146.51 → customer accepts extension 188.78 / 7.55 now / 181.23 extended.
